app.title: Salary Pulse
app.subtitle: A little progress, every day.
language.label: Language
dashboard.estimateNote: Estimated from your salary and schedule. Not an actual payment.
dashboard.shiftNote: Earnings pause during unpaid breaks. The countdown continues.
onboarding.title: A little more motivation
onboarding.subtitle: Set your salary and schedule, and we're ready to go.
onboarding.startFromShift: Estimate from the start of today's shift
onboarding.private: Your salary stays on your Mac. No account needed.
settings.title: Make It Your Own
settings.autoCalculationNote: Monthly salary is spread across the month's scheduled paid time. Working days and breaks update the calculation automatically.
settings.previewBudgetNote: Preview uses the displayed month's full schedule, not actual payment. Mid-month setup or changes accrue only after the effective time.
settings.previewEmpty: Enter your salary to see daily, hourly, and per-second estimates.
settings.autoTimezone: Read automatically from your Mac. No entry needed.
settings.divisorNote: 21.75 is an editable estimate parameter, not a payroll rule.
settings.notificationNote: Reminders are attempted while the app runs. macOS may limit delivery.
settings.notificationSent: Test requested. Check your system notification settings.
settings.autostartNote: Move the app to Applications before enabling this.
settings.resetConfirm: Delete this app's salary, schedule, preferences, and backups? You will return to setup.
settings.pending: Salary rules take effect on {{date}}. The current rules remain unchanged.
settings.nextDay: Salary and schedule changes begin on a safe later workday. Today is not recalculated.
settings.currencyNote: Language and currency are independent. No currency conversion.
settings.timezoneNote: To change time zones after setup, delete personal data and set up again.
about.title: Little Things Add Up
about.body: Salary Pulse is an offline-first, open-source workday companion. It estimates earnings using your own rules, not attendance tracking or payroll records.
about.privacy: No accounts, cloud sync, ads, or work monitoring. Your settings stay in local JSON files under your user account.
demo.label: Browser Demo
demo.note: Native features require the Mac app. Demo preferences stay in this browser only.
recovery.title: Your Settings Need Recovery
recovery.body: The file could not be read or is invalid. It has not been overwritten. Restore the last valid backup, or confirm a fresh start.
notification.clockOutBody: You've done enough for today. Save a little time for yourself.
notification.testBody: This is a test notification. Reminders never include your salary.
error.generic: That didn't work. Check your settings and try again.
error.REVISION_CONFLICT: Settings changed in another window. Reload before saving.
error.INVALID_SALARY: Enter a valid salary amount greater than zero.
error.INVALID_DIVISOR: Working days and paid hours must be positive and within range.
error.NO_PAID_TIME: No paid time is scheduled this month. Check working days, date exceptions, and breaks.
error.INVALID_SHIFT: A shift must be longer than zero and shorter than 24 hours. Select next day for overnight shifts.
error.INVALID_BREAK: The break must fit entirely inside the shift.
error.INVALID_TIMEZONE: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as America/New_York.
error.INVALID_WEEKDAYS: Select at least one working day.
error.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot save the local file. Check disk space and folder permissions.
error.INVALID_STATE: Local settings are invalid. Restore a backup or set up again.
error.INVALID_PREFERENCES: Check your name, language, and display preferences.
error.INVALID_QUIET_HOURS: Quiet hours cannot start and end at the same time.
error.NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME: This shift includes a time skipped by daylight saving. Adjust the schedule.
error.AMBIGUOUS_TIME_WARNING: This shift includes a repeated daylight-saving time. The earlier start and later finish are used.
error.TIMEZONE_RESET_REQUIRED: Changing time zones requires a fresh setup to protect existing shifts.
error.NO_SAFE_EFFECTIVE_DATE: No safe future start was found. Check your schedule.
error.MIXED_CURRENCY: Different currencies cannot be added. Adjust the effective date.
error.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Restore your settings or explicitly start again first.
error.DESKTOP_ONLY: This feature is available only in the installed Mac app.
message.1: A little slower is still a little further. You're making progress.
message.2: Do good work. Be good to yourself, too.
message.3: Your effort is adding up, one moment at a time.
message.4: Today doesn't need to be perfect. A step forward is enough.
message.5: Give yourself a little credit. Then keep going.
message.rest: Rest isn't falling behind. It's making room for your next step.
message.done: That's a wrap. Your effort today deserves a little appreciation.
